brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base piece:0,0,0;full with solid top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top, six solid end caps from capOpenFaces closing all side faces, and lockJoints applied; check_build clear with no open faces.

bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-pi inside the cell — a third-depth bin with four posts at Raspberry Pi mounting holes so the board sits on standoffs. No board prop exists in the prop catalog, so the board itself is represented by its mounting bin, not staged.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 is hex-port-louvre fitted in the enclosure wall; its catalog use is to vent a closed cell. It is the one deliberate opening in an otherwise capped enclosure.

finish.summary: A single-cell closed electronics enclosure: a full hex base holding a Pi-post bin (four standoffs at Pi mounting holes) for the board, closed with a solid top cover and solid end caps on all six side faces, joints locked. One wall carries a louvre port (hex-port-louvre) as the deliberate breathing vent. check_build is clear, meshClash clear, no open faces remaining.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
